_comment: Config for entity extraction: the app's backfill path (llm/EntityExtractor.kt) AND
the offline eval harness (tools/eval_entities.py) both read these values.
Kept SEPARATE from pipeline-config.json because the two paths are tuned
independently — different batch shape, different completion budget — but wired the
same way: the Gradle codegen (app/build.gradle.kts) emits these as ENTITY_* consts
on SharedConfig at build time, and check_shared_sync.py compares the generated
Kotlin against what Python loads. Never copy a value out of here into either
language; change it here and both sides pick it up on their next run.
TOKEN BUDGET MATHS (Groq free tier pre-counts input + max_completion_tokens
against a hard 8000 TPM cap, so every call must RESERVE its worst case):
completion  = completionBase + completionPerItem * batchSize, clamped so that
-> 8000 / 2770 = ~2.9 calls per rolling 60s window (~21s effective spacing)
tpmBudget is held under the 8000 hard cap so a mis-estimate does not 429.
